comparison.objective: Form a straight steel bar into a rectangular stirrup using three marked bends.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated high-force lever actuation and bar indexing, not fine rotary tuning or dynamic-response diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Three same-direction right-angle bends yield an 80×50 mm interior with meeting ends; reverse bending is scrap. Angle/end tolerances and spec versions are absent.
comparison.reason: This tests irreversible material forming rather than adjustable energy absorption.
